pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
第二届高光谱遥感数据处理与应用大赛

赛道三：高光谱高空间分辨率（双高）遥感影像精细分类

地表覆盖分类是遥感领域的核心研究内容，对生态环境保护、农业资源普查、城市可持续规划等具有不可替代的价值。本次比赛聚焦双高（高空间分辨率与高光谱分辨率）遥感影像，不仅具备数百个10nm级光谱分辨率的连续波段，还兼具0.6-5米精细的空间结构信息。本次比赛将打破传统框架，不仅考察算法在严格物理隔离设定下的泛化能力（训练测试场景分离），更考察其在开放环境中对未知类别的识别能力。期望通过本次比赛，推动高光谱精细分类技术向真实落地应用迈出坚实的一步。 **任务：**在开放环境下，基于高光谱影像对31个已知类别 + 1个“未知类”进行像元级分类。 **数据：**AVIRIS-Classic传感器数据（HyperFree预训练数据集子集），562张影像，224波段，400–2500 nm。 **评价指标：**Macro F1-score（主指标），总体精度（辅指标）。

The 2nd Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Data Processing and Application Competition

Track 3: Fine Classification of Dual‑High (High Spatial and Hyperspectral Resolution) Remote Sensing Imagery

Land cover classification is a core research topic in the field of remote sensing, offering indispensable value for ecological environment protection, agricultural resource inventory, and sustainable urban planning. This competition focuses on dual‑high (high spatial resolution and high hyperspectral resolution) remote sensing imagery, which features not only hundreds of continuous bands with ~10 nm spectral resolution but also fine spatial structural information at 0.6–5 meters. Breaking conventional frameworks, this competition evaluates not only the algorithm’s generalization capability under strictly isolated physical settings (with training and test scenes separated), but also its ability to recognize unknown categories in open environments. We hope that this competition will take a solid step forward in advancing hyperspectral fine classification technologies toward real‑world deployment.

Task: In an open environment, perform pixel‑level classification of 31 known classes + 1 “unknown class” based on hyperspectral imagery.

Data: AVIRIS‑Classic sensor data (subset of the HyperFree pre‑training dataset), 562 images, 224 bands, 400–2500 nm.

Evaluation Metrics: Macro F1‑score (primary metric), overall accuracy (secondary metric).

pages.title: Team Registration
pages.content:
组队要求：每队不超过5人（含队长1人），每人仅可加入一个团队，每队仅可选择一个赛道。

信息收集：所有参赛团队请将团队信息发送至所属赛道的指定邮箱zcg2025@whu.edu.cn。邮件主题请统一按“赛道名称－团队名称－队长姓名”格式填写，邮件正文中须注明全部队员姓名（含队长不超过5人）、所在单位及指导教师（如有）信息。

本竞赛允许跨单位、跨学校组队参赛。跨校组队团队须在报名邮件中完整注明每位队员的所在单位及指导教师信息；每名参赛者仅可加入一个团队。

Team Requirements:
Each team shall have no more than 5 members (including 1 team leader). Each participant may join only one team, and each team may select only one track.

Information Submission:
All participating teams are required to send their team information to the designated email address for their respective track: zcg2025@whu.edu.cn. The subject line of the email must follow the format: [Track Name] – [Team Name] – [Team Leader's Name]. In the body of the email, please clearly list the full names of all team members (no more than 5, including the leader), their affiliations, and the name(s) of supervisor(s), if applicable.

This competition allows participants to form teams across institutions and universities. Teams with members from different universities must clearly provide each member’s affiliation and advisor information, if applicable, in the registration email. Each participant may join only one team.

phases.description:
参赛团队请务必将团队信息发送至指定邮箱：**zcg2025@whu.edu.cn**。目前已经收到部分队伍的信息。未发送信息的队伍，其榜单成绩后续将按**无效处理**，无法获得比赛奖励。提交包含所有预测标签TIF的压缩包ZIP。**注意：不要有子文件夹，评测可能失败并占用提交次数**。

Participating teams must send their team information to the designated email: zcg2025@whu.edu.cn. We have received information from some teams so far. For teams that do not submit their information, their leaderboard scores will be treated as **INVALID**, and they will **NOT** be eligible for competition rewards. Submit a ZIP archive containing all predicted label TIF files. **Note: Do not include subfolders; otherwise, the evaluation may fail and it will consume one of your submission attempts.**
